summary: Loads a 7-element float array, dispatches on the mode selector this[7] (offset 0x1C) via a jump table: modes 0-5 store the first element as collision inverse mass and bulk-set the remaining six float fields, while mode 6+ returns immediately.

operations.description: Load float elements 0..6 from the array at a2 into the local staging values.
Load the mode selector from this[7] (offset 0x1C).
Dispatch on the mode selector via the jump table at global 0x0040EF54; cases 0 through 5 execute the processing path, the default case returns the mode value unchanged.
Call CollisionInvMassStore with the first float element and the element-1 storage to record collision inverse mass.
Call F_6FieldBulkSetter with the six remaining float elements to bulk-set six fields.
Return the mode selector value after processing, or immediately on the default path.
